name: Explainer Reel
tagline: Turn a topic or a script into a narrated explainer reel: a calm voice, word-timed captions and illustrations made of glowing particles.
youSay: /explainer-reel why the Moon is drifting away from us
whatYouGet: A 20–90 second explainer read by a calm, natural voice, captioned word by word, with every picture arriving on the word it answers to
Illustrations made of light: thousands of particles that form each subject and fly on into the next, turning 3D forms, flow fields and engraved drawings
A script written and fact-checked from your topic (or your own words, kept), a storyboard and a contact sheet of every scene before the render
MP4 in 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9, with an ambient soundtrack mixed under the voice
goodFit: Science, health, wellness and how-it-works topics told in under a minute
Faceless channels and brands posting explainers to Reels, TikTok, Shorts or YouTube
notFor: Footage, photos, screenshots or product demos
Presenters, avatars or fast, loud hype edits
youBring: Optional: the voice, the format and the look, or your own recording instead of the generated voice

network.purpose: playwright-core for the renderer and the Skillsmart CLI, installed once
